target_policy.anchor_policy: explicit raw-log keyword/severity else run_end_proxy; normal runs have no failure anchor

kpi.dimension_policy: Rows sharing one TimeStamp inside a host/metric file are aggregated to host-level mean_dim and max_dim. This deliberately collapses Device:/IFACE/cpu-slot dimensions while preserving host, metric, raw series and aggregation policy in feature names.

log.text_feature: log_text macro trailing normalized messages capped by MAX_LOG_TEXT_CHARS
